description: CALL THIS BEFORE QUOTING any Thirukkural verse — it letter-checks the quotation against the canonical corpus (Tamil or English accepted). Returns {verified, kural_id, tamil, english} on a match; when verified is false, do not present the quote — fetch a verified one with kural_guidance.

text.description: The quoted verse exactly as it will be presented (Tamil or English): a full verse, or a unique fragment of at least two words and ten characters

name: verify_quote
title: Letter-check a Thirukkural quote before presenting it
